_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0% of 72 windows producing a ±2+ point move, the coil is statistically dominant and a directional call would be hallucinating a breaker that neither brain can identify with conviction.
next_move.brains_agree: Both brains agree on HOLD direction — analyst explicitly calls HOLD with medium conviction, narrative implies patience setup — no directional split
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC breaks $65K with funding below 0.005% and spot CVD turning positive — genuine demand absorption
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC loses $60K with VIX spiking above 20 and exchange reserves climbing above 90 — distribution confirmed, forcing re-read toward Panic
